expected_output.correct_answer: String (Specific answer from list of options)

Explanation must reference key concept in simple terms.

Ensure question_duration stand for completion of all questions generated, not just one.
Ensure question_duration matches difficulty and interest.
Ensure hint is leading enough to arrive at the right answer
Ensure correct_answer includes actual value from the listed options
Ensure Array of question object is always returned, even if just one question.
